top_story.headline: Reps. Michael T. McCaul and Dan Crenshaw Still Have No 2025 Annual Financial Disclosure on File
top_story.dek: Both Texas Republicans are 54 days past their final extension date.
paragraphs: Rep. Michael T. McCaul (R-TX-10) filed an extension on April 29, 2026, and Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) on June 4, 2026. Both final extension dates passed on August 13, 2026, and neither has a calendar-year 2025 annual report in the Clerk of the House index or Senate eFD.

The check matches filings by name, so a report filed under a different spelling could be missed. Separately, seven confirmed officials have no posted ethics-agreement compliance certification more than 30 days past deadline, detailed in the Ethics Agreement Tracker section.

sections.headline: Two Officials Complete Required Divestitures; Two File New Ethics Agreements
paragraphs: Four Senate-confirmed presidential appointees filed ethics documents this period. Two submitted compliance certifications confirming completion of required divestitures, while two filed new ethics agreements with conflict-of-interest provisions. Additional routine transaction and annual disclosures were filed by State Department ambassadors and White House staff.

items: Peter-Anthony Pappas, Commissioner, U.S. International Trade Commission — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Completed all required divestitures within the timeframe specified in his ethics agreement (transaction report filed September 5, 2026).

George Holding, U.S. Executive Director, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, Department of the Treasury — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Completed all required divestitures within the timeframe specified in his ethics agreement (transaction report filed September 25, 2026).

Robert Steinau, Inspector General, National Aeronautics and Space Administration — Ethics Agreement. Standard conflict-of-interest provisions. Spouse employed by Hussman Strategic Advisors, Inc.; required to recuse from matters in which the firm is a party.

Justin Schwab, Assistant Administrator for Air and Radiation, Environmental Protection Agency — Ethics Agreement. Required to divest interests in Microsoft Corporation within 90 days of confirmation. Law firm (CGCN Law, PLLC) to remain dormant during appointment.

sections.headline: Two House Stock Reports and Two Candidate Filings; Maine Senate Candidate Troy D. Jackson Files
paragraphs: Two Periodic Transaction Reports, two House candidate reports and one Senate candidate report were new since the last edition. Both transaction reports were read in full (no cap reached): one is routine dividend reinvestment, the other a Treasury bill purchase.

items: Rep. Lloyd Doggett (D-TX-37) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on October 5, 2026 listing four purchases, each $1,001–$15,000 and each described in the filing as automatic reinvestment of dividends.

Rep. Vince Fong (R-CA-20) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on October 5, 2026 with a single transaction: a purchase of a U.S. Treasury bill (matures 12/10/2026) on September 18, 2026, $15,001–$50,000, held in a 529 College Savings Plan. It is a government security, so no stock trade is tabulated.

Troy D. Jackson (Maine Senate candidate, candidacy commenced July 9, 2026) filed a Candidate Report on October 5, 2026. It lists 2025–2026 self-employment income from International Association of Machinists ($90,000), International Union of Painters and Allied Trades ($48,000), Eastern Maine Labor Council ($5,100) and Food and Medicine ($4,800), with a spouse salary from the State of Maine. Assets are pensions, a life insurance policy, a Key Bank checking account ($15,001–$50,000), and spouse-owned Maine land and commercial property; no transactions were reported.
Te Brown (FL-14) filed a House Candidate Report on October 5, 2026.
Michael Anthony Murphy (PA-04) filed a House Candidate Report on October 4, 2026.

sections.headline: 17 New Lobbying Registrations, Led by Venezuela Energy and Defense Clients
paragraphs: The Senate LDA database shows 17 new registrations posted since October 5, 2026, among 282 total filings in the window (the rest are mainly third-quarter activity reports, which are due October 20). Ballard Partners signed three clients, two of them seeking Venezuela oil-and-gas opportunities, and Covenant Government Affairs, LLC registered Resource Rock Exploration LLC for a meeting with the U.S. chargé d'affaires on Venezuela. Client names link to the filings.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
